title: 第334章 实力上来了腰杆才硬第333章 万花宗要搬家
content_zh:
第334章实力上来了，腰杆才硬
嗡！
一股吞噬之力从他体内涌出，瞬间裹住手中长剑。
下一刻，剑身轻颤。
里面积攒的灵韵被一丝丝抽离，沿着纯小白的手掌涌入经脉，再汇入体内。
不到几个呼吸，长剑表面的光泽迅速暗淡，原本锋利的剑刃也渐渐失了灵性。
纯小白仔细感受片刻，随即睁开眼睛。
他没有急着下结论，而是抬手一翻，从储物戒指里取出五千万灵石，哗啦一声铺满房间。
浓郁的灵气顿时扑面而来。
“武神诀，再走一个！”
轰！
地上的灵石齐齐一震，灵气从中喷涌而出，汇成一股洪流，争先恐后地钻进纯小白体内。
不过几个呼吸，五千万灵石便被吞噬殆尽。
满地灵石失去光泽，化成灰白碎屑，轻轻一碰便散了一地。
纯小白分别比对了一番，眼睛渐渐亮了起来。
果然。
直接吞噬法器中的灵气，远比吸收灵石中的灵气来得快，更实在。
这也让他确定，武神诀根本就不是吸收灵石的路子，而是吸收万物灵韵。
只是这条路有一个麻烦。
高阶法器太难得了，高阶灵药太过稀少。

尤其是法宝，品质稍微高一点的平日市价都在千万灵石上下，可真正流入市面的少之又少。
大部分刚炼制出来，便被各方势力提前瓜分，寻常修士有钱都未必买得到。
方才他进万宝阁时，那掌柜抱着两件地阶法宝死活不肯松手。
一会儿说是镇店之宝，一会儿说是非卖品，还说什么需要登记身份、上报总阁、层层申请。
纯小白哪受得了这个？
给脸不要脸。
他当场把灵石往桌上一拍，一亿一件，这才硬生生让那掌柜闭了嘴。
若不是地阶法宝确实稀少，又早已被各大炼器宗门垄断，纯小白才懒得受这份刁难。
纯小白摸着下巴开始复盘这一趟有惊无险的生意。
这是他做事的习惯。
无论做什么事，即便是成功也要吸收成功经验，失败的话必须找到失败的原因。
这次万花宗之行，算是给他结结实实地上了一课。
说到底，还是实力不够。
若他修为足够强，何至于被那群老妖婆追得满山乱窜？
又何必封住气息，顶着一身茅坑味儿逃命？
实力上来了，腰杆才硬。
腰杆一硬，能抢的地方自然更多，能做的买卖也会更大。
归根结底，实力和搞钱本就是一回事。
没实力，眼前摆着一座灵石山，也只能干瞪眼。
有了实力，别人家的灵石山——那就是本大王暂存在他那里的！

砰砰砰！
砰砰砰砰砰！
纯小白刚准备一鼓作气，用剩下的灵石把修为拉上去，房门差点被人生生敲烂。
他翻身下床，没好气地一把拉开房门。
content_en:
Chapter 334: Only when you gain strength can you become stronger
Buzz!
A devouring force surged out of his body and instantly enveloped the sword in his hand.
The next moment, the sword trembled slightly.
The aura accumulated inside was pulled away bit by bit, poured into the meridians along Chun Xiaobai's palm, and then merged into the body.
In less than a few breaths, the luster on the surface of the long sword quickly dimmed, and the originally sharp blade gradually lost its spirituality.
Chun Xiaobai felt it carefully for a moment, then opened his eyes.
He did not rush to a conclusion, but raised his hand and took out 50 million spiritual stones from the storage ring, spreading them all over the room with a clatter.
The rich spiritual energy suddenly hit his face.
"Martial God Technique, one more move!"
Boom!
The spiritual stones on the ground shook together, and spiritual energy spurted out from them, forming a torrent and rushing into Chun Xiaobai's body.
In just a few breaths, fifty million spiritual stones were swallowed up.
The spiritual stones all over the ground lost their luster and turned into gray-white crumbs, scattering all over the ground with a light touch.
Chun Xiaobai compared them respectively, and his eyes gradually brightened.
really.
Directly swallowing the spiritual energy in the magic weapon is far faster and more practical than absorbing the spiritual energy in the spiritual stone.
This also confirmed to him that the Martial God Technique was not a way to absorb spiritual stones at all, but to absorb the aura of all things.
There's just one trouble with this road.
High-level magic weapons are too rare, and high-level elixirs are too rare.
Especially for magic weapons, the average market price of slightly higher quality ones is around tens of millions of spirit stones, but very few of them actually enter the market.
Most of them are divided up by various forces in advance as soon as they are refined, and ordinary monks may not be able to buy them if they have money.
When he entered Wanbao Pavilion just now, the shopkeeper was holding two earth-level magic weapons and refused to let go.
Sometimes they say it is a treasure of the store, sometimes they say it is not for sale, and they also say that they need to register their identity, report to the main office, and apply for it at all levels.
How can a pure noob stand this?
Shameless.
He slapped the spiritual stone on the table on the spot, one hundred million pieces, and then forced the shopkeeper to shut up.
If it weren't for the fact that earth-level magic weapons were indeed rare and had already been monopolized by major weapon refining sects, Chun Xiaobai wouldn't bother to endure this difficulty.
Chun Xiaobai touched his chin and began to review this near-miss business.
This is his habit.
No matter what you do, even if you succeed, you must absorb successful experience. If you fail, you must find the reason for the failure.
This trip to Wanhua Sect taught him a solid lesson.
In the final analysis, it is still not strong enough.
If his cultivation was strong enough, why would he be chased all over the mountain by those old witches?
Why seal your breath and run for your life smelling like a lagoon?
Once your strength is up, your waist will be strong.
Once the waist is strong, there will naturally be more places to grab, and the business that can be done will be bigger.
In the final analysis, strength and making money are the same thing.
Without strength, with a mountain of spiritual stones in front of him, he could only stare.
With strength, other people's Lingshi Mountain - that's what this king has temporarily stored with him!
Bang bang bang!
Bang bang bang bang bang!
Chun Xiaobai was just about to go all out and use the remaining spirit stones to pull up the cultivation base, but the door was almost knocked to pieces.
He rolled out of bed and opened the door angrily.
